quarterly_data.quarter: Bloom Energy press release: Bloom Energy Continues to Set the Standard for AI Onsite (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bloom Energy and MiTAC Computing Technology Corp. (a subsidiary of MiTAC Holdings Corporation) announced an expanded partnership: Bloom will deploy fuel cell systems for an islanded microgrid at MiTAC's AI server manufacturing campus in Fremont, California, building on an existing Bloom installation at MiTAC's San Jose manufacturing facility and increasing Bloom's total contracted capacity across the two California sites; the microgrid is to power current operations and give MiTAC flexibility to expand production. No MW, dollar value or in-service date is stated for the MiTAC project. Chief Commercial Officer Aman Joshi: 'Today, Bloom serves nearly two dozen AI infrastructure customers with approximately 250 MW of capacity, from a running start of nearly zero in this segment just two years ago.'
quarterly_data.figure: AI infrastructure segment: nearly two dozen customers, approximately 250 MW; MiTAC Fremont project size not stated
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (fuel-cell microgrids for MiTAC's AI server manufacturing sites in Fremont and San Jose)
